## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a082087b6e2506d5d7047e3c3e2ed45859bea029`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, content/docs/ai/agents.mdx, content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx, content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx, .changeset/31235-platform-skill-use-runtime-deploy-exit.md, packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/mcp/connect.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/dev-deploy-key.ts, packages/cli/package.json, packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts, skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md, skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json

Inputs read: card #31235 body, triage 6712265901 and claim 6716023699; PR #31335 body and its six-file list; the net diff against merge base `604a2b3b9`. `origin/main` (now `f5e23e2f7`) has not touched any changed or cited file since that base, so every line number below holds on both. Ruling 6513306068 (on #27847) was read at its source.

Check-runs on this head, read 2026-11-08T02:40Z: 38 in all. 10 success (Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Spec property liveness, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, filter, Auto Label), 12 skipped (UI-only and opt-in lanes), 16 in progress (Build Core, Build Docs, every Lint lane including docs and code guards and PM dispatch-gates, every Type Check lane, Plan Test Core shards, Live E2E UI). None failed. This verdict judges the contract. The in-progress gates give their own verdicts at merge.

The face is set by the committed tree. operations.md is a governed path, so the record is at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER and carries Scope and ④. I widened the scope to the whole diff. No part of it is left to the lane seat.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff adds nothing to any accept set and changes no public surface. No schema, export, flag or command changes. It is teaching text, a changeset and one ratchet row. Each claim, checked against `main`:

1. **`os mcp connect` and `--url`: right.** The command is `packages/cli/src/commands/mcp/connect.ts`. The CLI bin is `os` (`packages/cli/package.json` L23-26), so `npx os mcp connect` resolves in a scaffolded project, as `npx os dev --ui` already does in step 5 (build-with-claude-code.mdx L361). `--url` is declared at L140-142, and a `--url` server takes the name `OBJECTSTACK_MCP_SERVER_NAME` (L190), which is `'objectstack'` (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` L51). Without `--url`, the command needs a cloud credential (L193-197) and picks the environment (L235), so "registers your ObjectOS Cloud environment" is right.
2. **"Stores no token", and where `--header` goes: right.** connect.ts L25-30 says the command stores no MCP token and writes none into a client config. `claudeMcpAddArgs` (L62-65) builds `mcp add --transport http NAME URL` with no header. So the headless `x-api-key` header can only ride on a hand-typed `claude mcp add` line. agents.mdx now ties it to that line and says why. build-with-claude-code.mdx L511-512 is unchanged, as the card asked.
3. **The `d` key on a use-runtime target asks for no cloud login: right.** `dev-deploy-key.ts` L26-31 says so, L118 skips `runLogin` when a runtime target is set, and L188 wires `activeRuntimeTarget`. The new cli.mdx sentence matches the existing § To a self-hosted runtime, L3272-3273. Both anchors exist: `#deploy-to-a-self-hosted-runtime` at L3160 and `os mcp connect` at L3277. Check Documentation Links passed.
4. **Every use-runtime exit 1 in operations.md: right**, all in `deploy.ts`:
   - The runtime path runs only with no `--env` (L164). It never resolves a cloud credential (L301-355).
   - A failed build (L310-314).
   - A dry run refused or not served (L329-334, through `package/install.ts`).
   - A dry run an older runtime ignores, which then installs (install.ts L545-555, which says to upgrade the runtime).
   - An install refusal. The embedded install's retry is `os deploy` (deploy.ts L321, install.ts L323), and it prints `os deploy --confirm-access-upgrade FINDINGSET` (L468) or `os deploy --confirm-upgrade FINDINGSET` (L489). Both flags exist on `os deploy` (L140-155) and pass through (L337-340).
   - Installed but not loaded (L346-352: "it loads when the runtime restarts").
   The paragraph is more complete than cli.mdx itself, which leaves out `--confirm-upgrade` and the not-loaded exit. It does not contradict that page.
5. **The cloud paragraph: right.** It is unchanged apart from the ", cloud" scope label.
6. **Cut 1, the `os deploy` row's use-runtime tail (-92 B): nothing lost.** The tail said: no `--env`; build, dry-run plan, install, live on `hotLoaded`; `--confirm-access-upgrade TOKEN`. The new paragraph two lines down states every one of these, plus `--confirm-upgrade`. The row now points to it with "A `use-runtime` target: below".
7. **Cut 2, the permission-set pitfall row (-170 B): nothing lost.** The row only pointed elsewhere. Its fact lives in `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` § Assigning a permission set to a user (L35-37: "Declaring a set grants nobody anything — an assignment is data"). A reader gets there through the data skill: its description lists security and permission, and its SKILL.md L48 links that rules file for "permission sets, assignment rows". The platform skill keeps its own permission-set teaching (SKILL.md L123, L127, L383-386).
8. **Platform evals: none relies on the cut text.** The skill has one eval file, `config-plugins-ops.json`. No case mentions "grants nobody" or declaring versus assigning a permission set. Case 7 asks for `demoStaff` plus `permissionSets`, which SKILL.md still teaches. Case 17 is cloud-only, and the cloud paragraph still answers it. Case 21's expected output (dry-run plan, inline install, `hotLoaded`, `--confirm-access-upgrade TOKEN`, no `--env`) is fully in the new paragraph and the unchanged use-runtime row. Case 22 is about `os mcp connect`, and the row at L100 is unchanged. The PR changes no eval, which is correct.
9. **Ratchet: right.** `git show | wc -c` reads operations.md at 13360 B on main and 13500 B on this head. That is ceil/4 = 3340 and 3375, matching the script's `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`. Line by line: the row is -92 and the pitfall -170, for -262. Added: ", cloud" +7, the new paragraph +394, its blank line +1, for +402. Net +140 B, +35 tokens over a row that had 0 headroom, pinned at the measurement. Only that one `CEILINGS` row moves. The comment quotes 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 verbatim and names record 6513306068 on #27847, which is the recognised path that ruling sets out (part 2): same-file deletion shown and the ruling quoted. The PR body carries the ruling id and the measured delta.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` matches what the diff publishes. `packages/skills/package.json` ships the `skills` tree, and only teaching text in one reference file changes. No API, flag or schema moves. The three `content/docs/**` pages publish no package. The changeset and the PR body both carry `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. Both are right: no published contract widens or narrows, and no metadata protocol is involved. The claim 6716023699 carries the same two lines. The PR body says `Fixes #31235`. Check Changeset passed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The card's four sites:** all addressed. Site 2's headless line (L511) and the historical pages are left alone, as the card says. Every edit stays inside the claim's file surface. The ratchet row moves only under ruling 6513306068 and only for the measured remainder, as the claim set out.
- **Seat rulings the claim waits on (the cuts and the +35):** the PR body says the seat ruled before the script was touched. Whether or not that ruling is on the record, this review rules on the merits: both cuts and the +35 are sound (items 6, 7 and 9).
- **Model-mandate waiver:** the PR body cites the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-03, the same one the claim cites. That is outside a contract verdict. It is not escalated here.
- **"Other sites found (not edited)" in the PR body:** these are real and outside this card. On `main`, cli.mdx § `os deploy`'s flag table (L3237-3244) has no `--confirm-upgrade` row, step 3 (L3265-3267) names only `--confirm-access-upgrade`, and step 4 (L3268-3270) leaves out the not-loaded exit 1. Escalated: they need their own docs card, because no card holds them yet. The rest (connect-mcp.mdx and agents.mdx L108) are true as written.
- **Found in review, outside this card:** an embedded install's unique-scope refusal prints `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques` (install.ts L453, retry = `os deploy`). `os deploy` declares no such flag (deploy.ts L109-155), so the printed retry cannot run on a use-runtime target. This is a CLI gap that predates this PR. The new paragraph's install-refusal clause names only the two token flags `os deploy` takes, so it teaches nothing false. Escalated as a separate CLI card.
- **Dev `open_questions`:** none raised. No dev flag is left open.

### ④ Design judgment

operations.md, held against the card's site 3 and the spec it teaches on `main`. The fix keeps the paragraph short, as an agent-facing reference should be. The cloud paragraph is labelled as such and left word for word, so eval case 17 still holds. The use-runtime paragraph teaches the order and the exits from the code, not from cli.mdx, so it adds the two cases that page lacks without going beyond `deploy.ts`. Every refusal names its fix: upgrade the runtime, rerun with the printed token, or restart. The `os deploy` row pointing "below" and the cross-skill cut both follow the ruling's "cut duplication first" rule. Neither leaves a fact without a home that the skill router reaches. Nothing in the change is untrue against `main`, and nothing true is lost.

No must-fix. Should-fix, neither on this PR: open a docs card for the cli.mdx § `os deploy` gaps, and a CLI card for `--confirm-global-uniques` on `os deploy`.
